brief: Measures a two-dimension pivot table and computes the width of every column, the layout a console renderer draws from.
detail: It is built from the pivot as a list of rows: a header row (the row labels, one dim1|dim2 header per data column, the total label), the data rows and a row of totals. It measures the content into aContentDimensions, then turns measures and settings into aCalculatedLayout; both are attributes you read directly. The settings are in aSettings (MinCellWidth, MaxCellWidth, MaxHeaderWidth, DefaultPadding, CellGrowthRatio and others), and SetSetting recomputes after each change. Known limits: it needs exactly two column dimensions, and today the width of a data column ignores its content, which the warnings on CalculateLayout and MeasureContentDimensions explain.
